title: 2018 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Dog
seo_title: 2018 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Dog (16 February – 4 February 2019)
description: 2018 is the Year of the Earth Dog (Yang, Wu-xu), from 16 February 2018 to 4 February 2019. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2018.
lead: Born in 2018? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dog, but check the date: the 2018 Earth Dog year began on 16 February 2018. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2018: Year of the Earth Dog, from 16 February 2018 to 4 February 2019.

image.alt: Golden Dog of the Chinese zodiac in front of a moonlit temple
image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2018 was the Year of the Dog. It began with Lunar New Year on 16 February 2018 and ended on 4 February 2019, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2018 ends in 8, which makes it an Earth year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2018 is a Wu-xu year. The same Earth Dog combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1958 before it and 2078 after it.
Lunar New Year 2018 fell on 16 February 2018, so everyone born in January 2018, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rooster.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dog guide describes the sign like this: “Loyal, honest, and protective. Dogs are deeply trustworthy and stand up for what they believe in.” The usual watch-out: “Can be anxious or overly suspicious of new situations.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Dog page.
Careers often linked with the Dog: law, security, social work, education.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2018
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dog's best matches are the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit, and its clash sign is the Dragon, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dog, it shares the Horse's triangle, so 2026 is traditionally one of its friendlier years.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dog, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dog years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1994 (Wood Dog); 2006 (Fire Dog); 2030 (Metal Dog). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2018 is the Year of the Dog, a Yang Earth Dog year (Wu-xu).
When does the 2018 Year of the Dog start and end?
It starts on 16 February 2018 and ends on 4 February 2019.
I was born in January 2018. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rooster: Lunar New Year 2018 was on 16 February 2018, so all of January 2018 belongs to the Rooster year.
Earth. 2018 ends in 8, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dog compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit. The Dog's clash sign is the Dragon.
